_readme: Parity registry (AGENTS.md "Parity"; kitbag.py parity, lint PARITY). adapters.<family>: config key, code file, verbs, caps (Test-KitCap), built-in names, vendor names; fallback.<verb> = what the kit does instead, same outcome (an optional verb); gaps."<name>[,<name>]/<verb>[,<verb>]" = what does not work there and why (kitbag.py parity next lists it to close; a gap the tool cannot close: "no such feature: <its doc link> <why>"); capKeys.<cap> = the keys that turn it on; parity = why a family is not walked. harness: hooks (settings.json hook -> the port's command, else "gap: <why>" | "fallback: <how>"), features (Claude Code-only features, the same values).

adapters._readme: README Adapters; code: Register-KitAdapter <kind> <name> @{ <verb> = {...} } (ps1) or ADAPTERS['<kind>']['<name>'] = {...} (py)

tracker.verbs: view url status comment comments create describe rename list owner
tracker.caps: checklist commentEdit commentDelete statuses move attach dependencies labels
tracker.vendors: clickup github gitlab jira jira-server linear youtrack azure

fallback.checklist: an Items block in the description (<!-- kit:<name> -->)
fallback.dependencies: a **Waits on:** line in the description
fallback.labels: tags (kitbag.py naming tags): a <!-- kit:tags --> **Tags:** line in the description (task-items.ps1 Set-KitTaskTags)

git-host.verbs: mr.get mr.list mr.changes mr.create mr.update mr.merge mr.unauto mr.url mr.parseRef whoami repo.base repo.commit repo.compare branch.protect

fallback.mr.labels: a Tags: line in the MR body (devtools.py mr_labels)

gaps.bitbucket/mr.labels: no such feature: https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/bitbucket/rest/api-group-pullrequests/ Bitbucket Cloud pull requests have no labels; the Tags: body line (fallback) stands

fallback.tags: the Tags: line under the doc title (devtools.py with_tags, every store); gdocs: Drive properties, confluence: page labels

gaps.markdown,html,command/selftest: no self-check: the first publish reports the error

ci.verbs: runs jobs log status config failure parseUrl
ci.vendors: github gitlab bitbucket azure gitea jenkins

fallback.failure: core Get-KitCiFailure (the failed job and its log)

gaps.codex,antigravity,none/agentMeta: SendMessage is Claude Code-only: nothing to look up

deploy-kind.names: command ci-job branch-mr ssh tag probe manual awsStack laneApk

gaps.probe,awsStack,laneApk/deploy: check-only kinds: a person deploys, then bossy.ps1 deploy record
gaps.branch-mr,ssh,tag,probe,manual,laneApk/i: no in-flight state: the deploy board shows none for the target
gaps.ci-job,branch-mr,tag,probe,manual,awsSta: no service restart: deploy restart refuses (ssh and command kinds restart)

fallback.lastDeploy: the kit's deploy log (bossy.ps1 deploy run / record) of the target: the deploy board's last time

gaps.env/write,set,delete,rotate: no such feature: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/procthread/environment-variables a process changes only its own environment and its children's, never the owner's shell or CI that set it (UNSUPPORTED names it; a written file would be a second store: use file or keychain)

process-gate.parity: a built-in is one rule for its own gates (testingDocs: promote here, finish / merge / mrBody in devtools.py; reproRow: bugFix in devtools.py); an unset gate passes

db-engine.vendors: mysql mariadb postgres sqlserver sqlite oracle mongodb redis elasticsearch opensearch

fallback.query: the env's db.query line (db-presets.ps1 fills only what the env lacks)

gaps.redis/sql: no such feature: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ commands on keys, no statement language with rows: Invoke-DbSql refuses (db.schemasQuery, tenants column model); envy.ps1 sql runs the query preset (raw commands)
gaps.postgres,sqlserver,sqlite,oracle,mongodb: no binlog marks: restore by seed
gaps.mariadb,postgres,sqlserver,sqlite,oracle: no temp-space watchdog or pool check

gaps.none/list,drop,import,footprint: no tenants: every verb works on the db scope
gaps.column/drop,import,footprint: tenants are column values in one shared scope: list only
gaps.instance/drop,import,footprint: one server per tenant: list only

migration.verbs: check discover pendingSql tag rollback resetEdited missingRoutines rerunRoutines historyScopes

device.verbs: dump tap tapid tapxy type clear key swipe openurl shot shotmark wait photo log mic

gaps.ios/photo,mic: no such feature: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/xcode/testing-in-simulator-versus-testing-on-hardware-devices a Simulator has no camera and no audio injection: pokey.ps1 ui refuses, naming the ios actions; prove it on an android lane or by hand
gaps.none/dump,tap,tapid,tapxy,type,clear,key: no device lanes (devices.type none): app checks are NOT_TESTED
